note: The session's web search allowance was already used up, so nothing was searched: findings come from pages opened directly (county governments' own sites where the address could be found, the South Dakota Democratic Party's 2026 pages, SDPB's 2026 candidate profiles and the campaign sites they link). Blanks mean not looked up, not that nothing exists. Checked and not found on the county's or city's own page: Manuel Langstraat (Brookings County officials page names another sheriff), Haley Gallant (Mellette County's Register of Deeds page names another person), William Shorma (Union County commissioners page), Sam Hummel (Yankton City Commission page), Jason Kari (Butte County commission page). SDPB's profile of Blake Stevens was read as saying District 6; his own site and our record say District 7. Blake Rife and Evangeline Poor Bear have only a Facebook page per SDPB, which is not recorded.
